ITEM.PTXT: While maintaining the required outlet temperature, the air conditioning computer calculates the target evaporator fin temperature required to prevent discomfort due to the temperature difference between the inside and outside of the cabin and cabin humidity, and to prevent window fogging. In addition, it calculates target evaporator fin temperatures that take into account discomfort caused by excessively high temperatures from each outlet in FACE and BI-LEVEL outlet modes and quick defogging in DEF mode, and by comparing these, determines the target evaporator fin temperature that minimizes power consumption according to the vehicle condition. By using this for compressor control, both necessary and sufficient cooling capacity and low fuel consumption are achieved.
